passesHint: Keep the original recognition and compare it with processed images. More passes take longer.

outputs.json: JSON with provenance and review audit

quality.low-resolution: Small image: character strokes may be missing; use a clearer source.
quality.blur: Possible blur; retake the photo if text is unreadable.
quality.glare: Unusual bright patches: glare may have erased strokes; retake the photo.
quality.skew: Added a deskewed recognition pass; the original image is preserved.
quality.perspective: Added a pass with corrected paper corners; the original image is preserved.
quality.handwriting-unsupported: No validated handwriting model is available. Check all experimental output against the original image.

disagreement: Recognition passes disagree; a high score still requires review.
tableHint: Check rows, columns, blank cells and merged cells before confirming the table.
tableMissing: No reliable table detected. Create a table and transcribe values from the image.
mergeRight: Merge with the cell on the right
confirmTable: I checked the table against the original image

validationCodes.ambiguous-money: Ambiguous money separators; re-enter as an integer

validationHint: Fix required errors before export; check total and duplicate warnings.
tableRequired: Select Data table and confirm a table before exporting CSV or XLSX.
cornersHint: Select top-left, top-right, bottom-right, then bottom-left on the image. You can adjust percentage coordinates with the keyboard. Applies to the first page; other pages use the original image.
cornersSelectFile: Choose a file to preview and select paper corners.
waitingReview: Waiting for your review and confirmation.
csvHint: CSV prefixes leading-zero identifiers and formula-like values with an apostrophe to prevent spreadsheet conversion. Choose XLSX to preserve the exact string values.
modelUnavailable: The recognition model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
